changelog:
Initial release with automated WeChat Official Account draft publishing:

- Publish HTML articles to WeChat drafts, handling cover upload, auto-generated covers, body image rewriting, and CSS variable compatibility.
- Provides scripts for uploading articles, images, and publishing with auto-generated covers.
- Supports default author/comment settings, and automatically adjusts HTML for WeChat compatibility.
- Requires Node.js ≥16, with optional bun for automatic cover generation.
- Detailed workflow and environment configuration included for quick setup.
summary: Use when publishing HTML articles to WeChat Official Account drafts, especially when you need cover upload, automatic cover generation, body image rewriting,...
